cause.source: The unchanged public regression loop raises Keyboard.KeyDownEvent on BarcodeBox. The previous H1 XAML registered PreviewKeyDown only, so a directly raised bubbling KeyDown did not reach the scanner command. A failure on the first scan is consistent with a missing event binding rather than submission-guard release after a previous scan.

checks: BarcodeBox registers both PreviewKeyDown and the restored KeyDown surface. KeyDown forwards to the same scanner handler rather than duplicating scanner parsing or command logic.

The common handler returns immediately when e.Handled is set. Non-empty accepted input is marked handled before command execution; therefore a consumed preview cannot submit again through the bubbling path.
Preview handling remains in place for configured Tab before focus navigation. Empty input and configured terminator behavior remain unchanged.
IME composition, repeat, modifier and scanner-terminator guards remain unchanged after the new handled guard.
The existing asynchronous VM command and submission-in-progress guard remain unchanged.
No regression assertions, fixture input event, timeouts, delays or scanner settings were weakened or changed by this correction.
The delta is limited to two XAML additions/one removal and eight code-behind additions; no scanner normalization or sale workflow changes.
